status: Finite joined trial; conditional dimensional screens only, no qualified assembly or operating pass

tower.scope: Four-standard 1400 x 2570 axis trial; 65 outer allowance on each face is an authored reservation, not a manufacturer outer dimension. Actual brackets and assembly require supplier confirmation.

shutter.scope: 300 by 300 housing and 48 guides are reservations, not selected product dimensions; actual slat, manual operator, base, seal, anchorage and freeze/jam recovery remain unproved.

states: Before opening the building leaf, operate the shutter from the court side until its entire curtain and bottom slat clear the leaf; closed curtain reproduces the earlier trapped-first-motion failure.

Keep the court-south door isolated from ordinary occupants only under an independently established occupation, front-exit and fire policy. Court-side crank access and unpowered operation are not yet a proved rescue.

For wet pause, restore the shutter, screen/base/roof protection and complete drainage before leaving. Frozen, jammed or obstructed curtain is a distinct failed state; no emergency egress is credited to the shutter.
limits: The tower frame, stairs, jacks, ties, bracing, guards, landings, worker/descent/rescue envelopes and its intersection with the working deck remain undesigned; the two boxes are not a complete assembly.

Housing and guide envelope is assumed, not product data. Product selection, usable clear opening, housing projections, supports, both-side controls, force, wind, seals, freezing and recovery remain to be obtained.
Roof weathering during receiver removal, screen ends and base, deck capture, inlet and surface relief, blocked/common-failure and a safe site destination remain open.
No gantry, slings, carrier travel or loaded A lift is established by placing a stair tower. No safe egress, physical performance or capacity pass is claimed.
